failure.summary: The whole 19-minute episode was spent installing the dependencies the prompt says are preinstalled (torch, torchvision, mobile_sam, Pillow); torch 1.13.1+cpu eventually installed but torchvision kept hanging, and /app/convert_masks.py was never written, so the grader failed with "can't open file '/app/convert_masks.py'".

evidence_quotes.quote:
root@29f85bec:/app# python3 -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__)"
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'
ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement mobile-sam (from versions: none)

candidates.why_relevant: The card covers exactly this situation: ModuleNotFoundError for a package that provides a required loader, with local caches, wheels, mirrors and alternate endpoints to try, and requires proving success with the task's consumer command rather than an install log.

pending_relevant.why_relevant: Pending card on captures for long-running work: diagnose installs that never finish and verify every required tool actually runs before continuing - the exact loop that consumed this trial.
Pending closed-plan card; a plan that names convert_masks.py as the deliverable would have prevented spending the entire budget on environment setup.

skill_use.detail: It opened bank/merge/0000 but did not follow its core requirement: no consumer/acceptance command was ever run, and it never fell back to writing the deliverable while dependencies were unavailable. It also never fetched the MobileSAM source, which the sibling attempts obtained from a GitHub tarball in a couple of steps.

verdict.rationale: The prompt promises torch, torchvision, opencv, Pillow and mobile_sam preinstalled, but none of them (nor any MobileSAM checkpoint) existed in the container, so the agent burned the entire episode on installation; its handling was also poor, but no script could have run without torch.
